reference.title: Triceps Dip
reference.listing: Animated GIF (title and number from the catalog listing; the page could not be read from this environment, so the movement follows the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you press up.
breathing.cadence: About 2 s down, short pause, about 1.3 s up

prescription.progression: More reps, then a dip belt with added load; build up from bench dips or assisted dips if a full rep is not yet possible

cues.text: Jump or step up to straight arms on the bars, hands under the shoulders, palms in; shoulders down away from the ears, knees bent, trunk nearly upright.
Breathe in and bend the elbows straight back, lowering under control with the trunk upright.
Stop when the upper arms are about parallel to the floor; shoulders stay down, chest open.
Breathe out and push the bars away to straighten the arms.
Arms straight but not locked, shoulders pressed down; repeat.

mistakes.fix: Stop at upper arms about parallel to the floor; dips take the shoulder far into extension (McKenzie 2022).

mistakes.mistake: Shoulders shrugging up toward the ears at the bottom
mistakes.fix: Keep pressing the shoulders down; shorten the range if they rise.
Bend the elbows straight back, close to the body.

mistakes.mistake: Swinging the legs to get up
mistakes.fix: Keep the knees bent and still; press with the arms.

mistakes.mistake: Leaning far forward when the goal is the triceps
mistakes.fix: Stay nearly upright; a strong forward lean turns it into a chest dip.

kinematics.norm: Arms straight but not locked at the top; elbow flexion at the bottom of a bar dip was larger than in a bench dip (McKenzie 2022); upper arms about parallel is a common limit (clinical opinion)
Nearly upright for the triceps version; a forward lean shifts the work toward the chest (clinical opinion)

kinematics.measure: Upper arm angle to the floor
kinematics.norm: Stop with the upper arms about parallel to the floor (clinical opinion); bar dips reached about 95% of the maximal shoulder extension range in the study group (McKenzie 2022)
The body moves straight down and up between the bars; the feet stay off the floor (clinical opinion)
Controlled, about 2 s down and 1-1.5 s up (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #081413, Triceps Dip, animated GIF (movement reference)
McKenzie, Crowley-McHattan, Meir, Whitting and Volschenk 2022, bench, bar, and ring dips: do kinematics and muscle activity differ? (Int J Environ Res Public Health 19(20):13211; PMC9603242)

Boehler 2011, electromyographic analysis of the triceps brachii muscle during a variety of triceps exercises (MS thesis, University of Wisconsin-La Crosse, ACE-sponsored; 15 women, 8 exercises at 70% 1RM)

cautions: Shoulder: dips take the shoulder far into extension under body weight, which loads the front of the shoulder (McKenzie 2022); keep the range to upper arms about parallel and stop if the front of the shoulder hurts.
Skip it with a history of shoulder instability or pain at the front of the shoulder.
Use a stable station; step down, do not drop, from the bars.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness or tingling occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Shoulder discomfort: shorter range (stop with the elbows at about 60 degrees).
Assisted dip machine or a band looped under the knees.
regressions: Bench dip with the knees bent.
Negative-only dips: step up to the top, lower slowly, step down.

muscleNotes.triceps_r: Main mover: straightens the elbow against body weight; triceps activity in the bar dip was high and similar to the other dip variants (McKenzie 2022).
muscleNotes.pec_r: Lower chest helps press the body up from the bottom, more so with a forward lean (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Front deltoid works with the chest as the shoulder comes out of extension (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lats_r: Help hold the shoulders down and the body steady between the bars (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Keep the shoulder blades set (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Main mover: straightens the elbow against body weight; triceps activity in the bar dip was high and similar to the other dip variants (McKenzie 2022).
muscleNotes.pec_l: Lower chest helps press the body up from the bottom, more so with a forward lean (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Front deltoid works with the chest as the shoulder comes out of extension (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lats_l: Help hold the shoulders down and the body steady between the bars (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Keep the shoulder blades set (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk upright and the legs still.
